meta.title: Add caching for RunPod PDF markdown results in GCS
meta.body_summary: Add caching for RunPod PDF markdown results in Google Cloud Storage using content hash, reducing redundant API calls and improving response times for repeated PDF conversions.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added GCS caching with content hash; nickscamara approved without comment; merged under 44 minutes with no perf evidence.

core_change_summary.description: Added gcs-pdf-cache.ts module to store/retrieve cached RunPod markdown results in GCS using SHA-256 hash of PDF content as key. Modified PDF engine index.ts to check cache before calling RunPod and store results afterward. Added unit tests covering cache hits, misses, and hash consistency.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test file adds 138 lines covering cache behavior but does not produce runtime performance metrics.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Added caching logic and tests.
Second commit: Updated hashing to use base64 directly and added metadata.
Third commit: Fixed hashing to directly hash content and adjusted test expectations.
